title: E0113: Session Regeneration Missing
plain_english: Calling `session_start()` and writing session data after authentication without calling `session_regenerate_id()` can leave the application vulnerable to session fixation attacks.
why_matters: Session fixation allows an attacker to: - Authenticate using a session ID they chose - Hijack the session after the victim logs in - Access the victim's authenticated account
what_it_checks: `session_start()` followed by `$_SESSION` writes without a subsequent `session_regenerate_id()`
Login/auth endpoints that set session data without regenerating the ID
